Their `createValue MAIN_DRUID_ORDER = "cultivation"` is bookkeeping for a select answer, not a printed statistic; ours is the pick itself (classes.druid.subclass.options['cultivation-order'] -> build.subclassId). Taught by adding 'cultivation-order': ['specialStat'] to VERIFIED_EQUIVALENT in scripts/wg-diff.mjs, beside the eight orders already there (flame/spore/stone b033, animal/leaf/storm/untamed/wave b034) whose note explicitly held this one back until its grants were checked. Scope is the KINDS lane only: the anathema is description prose and the leaf-order membership is a giveAbilityBlock the EXPERIENCE comparer still reports.

Instrument park, no data row - and NOT a settle registry. WG's granted-spell ladder is the LEGACY printing (AoN conscious-mind-3: 2nd Heat Metal, 4th Fire Shield, 6th Flame Vortex, 7th Fiery Body) while our record IS the remaster one (conscious-mind-9, edition 'remaster': 2nd Blazing Bolt, 4th Ice Storm, 6th Frozen Fog, 7th Volcanic Eruption), so four of their giveSpells can never deliver and adopting them would move us away from print. Recorded in work/experience-instrument-limits.json under lane 'wg-legacy-spell-name', the lane the-distant-grasp (b33) and the-infinite-eye (b34) are already parked in. The entry states its own limit: it does NOT cover the-oscillating-wave#conservation-of-energy, which is a real experience-visible gap owned by another family and fixed by a create row in this same batch. Pinned by test/batch035-instruments-1.test.ts against the AoN mirror and our carrier.
